_howto: Name files MB-OC-<siman>-<skFrom>-<skTo>.mp3 with three digits each, e.g. MB-OC-429-001-004.mp3. The page reads the siman and seif katan from the filename. Add a topic line for each. For a shiur crossing into the next siman use MB-OC-429-014-to-430-003.mp3. A bare filename with no topic also works: just "audio/MB-OC-430-001-006.mp3",

shiurim.topic: Shoalin v'dorshin b'hilchos haPesach shloshim yom kodem; the Shabbos HaGadol drasha
Ma'os chittim, and the halachos of chodesh Nissan
